sasha.product: Heads-up 1: were drafting a pricing/packaging play for microtiers focused on partner resell and EU pilots. want to capture surcharges, pilot deposit flows, and what constitutes an SLA-eligible customer.
leo.sales: partners asked for a low-barrier pilot (4-6 weeks) but they want 'demo-grade' SLA ~99.7. can we offer reduced SLA for pilots without full addon purchase?
marta.legal: short answer: yes but must be explicit "pilot SLA" clause and sunset date. no implied permanence. also need EU data residency surcharge spelled out in contract (e.g., +15% infra pass-through).
hui.eng: infra feasibility: we can tag tenant regions and route to EU pools, but reserved capacity for partners requires a different autoscaling policy and a per-tenant billing token so revops can track surcharges. estimate 3 sprints for first pass.
ryan.finance: financial constraints: any surcharge must be itemized on invoice and map to cost centers. pilot deposit should be refundable minus usage and any credit risk. propose pilot-deposit = min(20% expected 3mo ARR, $10k).
omar.revops: operationally we need clear flags: `pilot_type:partner`, `residency:eu`, `sla:pilot-99.7` so billing + console can show status. I'll draft tagging and a backfill script.
diana.support: support implications: pilot SLA still needs runbook for incident credits. For pilot SLA we'll provide a single-point escalation to partner AE, not full 24/7. document in support matrix.
sasha.product: proposed package (for discussion):
```
MicroStarter: free, 50k tokens/mo, no SLA, no EU residency guarantee
MicroPartnerPilot: $250/mo + deposit, 500k tokens, pilot-SLA 99.7, expires in 6 weeks, EU residency option (+15% surcharge)
MicroGrowth: $750/mo, 3M tokens, 99.5 SLA default, optional Priority addon +$1.5k/mo => 99.9 SLA with reserved burst
```
leo.sales: can we add a reseller discount bucket? partners want 10% off list if they commit 6 months. also need clear language that discount != SLA entitlement.
ryan.finance: reseller discount OK but discount flow must be tied to a contract field `reseller:code` and cannot trigger SLA automatically. credits cap: for microtiers cap credits at lesser of 10% of 12mo revenue or $30k.
marta.legal: add clause: pilot deposits refundable within 30 days of pilot end minus usage and any damages. explicit opt-in required to convert pilot to paid tier. also EU surcharge flows to infra partner, not Redwood P&L.
hui.eng: telemetry ask: well emit a per-tenant `residency` label and `pilot_flag`. console needs a mini-badge on tenant view. that's a small UI task.
omar.revops: migration/backfill: 1) tag existing reseller tenants 2) add invoice line item code `EU-RESID`. Ill coordinate with billing vendor.
diana.support: for partner pilots, we need an FAQ for AEs covering: deposit handling, SLA differences, what counts as outage, how credits are applied. I'll draft.
sasha.product: launch gating checklist I want recorded: 1) contracts/pilot clause + legal signoff 2) billing tag + invoice line item 3) console badge + telemetry 4) support runbook + AE FAQ 5) finance validation of deposit flow
ryan.finance: add: reporting dashboard to reconcile deposits monthly and a chargeback process for EU infra ops. I'll own the dashboard.
leo.sales: quick ask: can we support custom pilot lengths for strategic accounts? eg 2 weeks pilot for dev partners. should be case-by-case with finance ok.
marta.legal: yes but require written exception + product/finance sign-off.
hui.eng: timeline: reserve policy + telemetry (3 sprints), console badge (1 sprint), billing tags (1 sprint) => earliest ship in 5 sprints if prioritized.
sasha.product: tradeoff note: priority addon + EU residency together increase ops complexity; prefer soft launch limited to 10 partners first.
omar.revops: I'll prepare a pilot-run checklist and tagging spec. expected work: 2 engineers half-time for one sprint to build tagging and backfill script.
diana.support: support staffing note: we need at least 1 on-call SME for partner pilots for the first 8 weeks of program.
bot-ci: CI reminder: all infra changes must pass e2e tests and be merged by 2026-02-10 to meet Q1 pilot window.
sasha.product: thanks team 1 action items: leo send partner list, ryan confirm deposit accounting workflow, marta prep pilot clause template, hui create infra epic. will sync on Thu 30m.
